displayName: OCI-API-002: API2: Broken Authentication — Default Credentials
description:
Detects API authentication attempts using default or well-known credentials

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api2%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%broken%') AND "value" > 0
